sloka: स पुत्रवधसन्तप्तः शूरः क्रोधवशं गतः।समीक्ष्य रावणो बुद्ध्या सीतां हन्तुं व्यवस्यत ।। ६.९३.३४ ।।
transliteration: sa putravadhasantaptaḥ śūraḥ krodhavaśaṁ gataḥ।samīkṣya rāvaṇo buddhyā sītāṁ hantuṁ vyavasyata ।। 6.93.34 ।।

translations.english: Feeling very sad about the death of his son, cruel Ravana overpowered by anger went thinking to destroy Sita.
